name: Web Push — RFC 8030 / 8291 / 8292 sender
description: VAPID JWT signing + ECDH-ES + HKDF + AES-128-GCM payload encryption + POST to push endpoint, plus subscription store for the chuck-v3 PWA. Wraps the `web-push` npm lib. Used by @openclaw/plugin-chuck-pwa for /push/* endpoints and @openclaw/skill-reach-cascade for the web-push channel attempter. Salvages chuck-web-push.mjs.
